summary: Added fixture-only coverage around the extension guard threshold. Coverage proves the current guard caps only the overextended/rich yes-price shape while preserving paper-candidate decisions below either side of the combined threshold and preserving the legitimate BTC candidate decision.
limitations: Coverage is fixture-only and characterizes the current extension rule; it does not broaden the guardrail.
The legitimate candidate is preserved as a scorer/review paper_candidate; the coverage paper action can still be no_action if aggregate paper notional limits are exhausted by earlier fixture rows.
No live fetchers, APIs, credentials, wallets, real orders, live trading, runtime integration, prompt automation, unrelated cleanup, or new validation layer was added.
